Class NestedJarEntry

java.lang.Object
java.util.zip.ZipEntry
java.util.jar.JarEntry
io.micronaut.runner.NestedJarEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public final class NestedJarEntry extends JarEntry
One entry of a NestedJarFile, built from an index record instead of from a central directory header.

Everything a library reads off a JarEntry comes from the record: the name, the uncompressed and compressed sizes, the CRC, the compression method and the timestamp. A library that walks a jar to decide what to do with each entry, and there are several in a Micronaut application, therefore sees exactly what it would see if the dependency were a jar file of its own on the class path.

Versioned entries

When the record is a multi-release alias, ZipEntry.getName() is the base name the caller asked for and getRealName() is the META-INF/versions/<n>/... entry that actually holds the bytes, which is exactly the distinction JarFile draws for a versioned entry of an ordinary jar.

Since:
1.0

  • Method Details

    • dosTimeToMillis

      public static long dosTimeToMillis(long dosTime)
      Converts a packed MS-DOS date and time word, as a ZIP header stores it, into epoch milliseconds in UTC.

      ZipEntry converts the same word in the default time zone, which makes the instant it reports depend on where the machine is. The packager computes its timestamps in UTC, so converting back in UTC is what round trips them, and it keeps a build reproducible across time zones. The arithmetic is the civil-from-days algorithm, so nothing on this path loads java.time or a calendar.

      Parameters:
      dosTime - the packed date and time, as Index.entryDosTime(int) returns it
      Returns:
      the instant in epoch milliseconds, or -1 when the word records no time
